text: Seek first, then, for the predominant passion of the character which you mean to engage and influence, and address yourself to it; but without defying or despising the inferior passions; get them in your interest too, for now and then they will have their turns.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter XCVII, to his son, London, December 19, Old Style 1749
